course.title: Unit 5 Fun Clubs【例句】
course.description: SECTION B What can you learn in a school club?

sentences.chinese: 加入我们的烹饪俱乐部！

sentences.content: Let's learn to cook your favourite Chinese food.
sentences.english: Let's learn to cook your favourite Chinese food
sentences.chinese: 让我们来学习烹饪你最爱的中国菜。

sentences.content: You can soon cook for your family.
sentences.english: You can soon cook for your family
sentences.chinese: 你很快就能为家人下厨了。

sentences.content: Come hiking with us every Sunday afternoon!
sentences.english: Come hiking with us every Sunday afternoon !
sentences.chinese: 每周日下午和我们一起来徒步吧！

wordDetails.definition: hike（现在分词）: 徒步旅行

sentences.content: We watch birds, take photos, and collect plants and insects.
sentences.english: We watch birds , take photos , and collect plants and insects
sentences.chinese: 我们观察鸟类、拍摄照片，并采集植物和昆虫标本。
我们还会参观自然公园。

sentences.content: Discover wildlife right under your nose!
sentences.english: Discover wildlife right under your nose !
sentences.chinese: 发现近在咫尺的野生动物！

sentences.content: We act out stories, talk about books, and make new friends.
sentences.english: We act out stories , talk about books , and make new friends
sentences.chinese: 我们演绎故事，谈论书籍，结交新朋友。

sentences.content: Books can open your mind and make you think.
sentences.english: Books can open your mind and make you think
sentences.chinese: 书籍能开阔你的思维，引发你的思考。

sentences.content: Come to the library on Tuesdays after school and fall in love with books!
sentences.english: Come to the library on Tuesdays after school and fall in love with books !
sentences.chinese: 每周二放学后来图书馆，爱上阅读吧！
